blocks.text: HOCl aur OCl- dono moassar disinfectants hain, magar HOCl apne neutral charge ki wajah se zyada moassar hai, jo use micro-organisms ki cell deewaron mein aasani se ghusne deta hai. Proteins aur lipids jaise zaroori cellular ajza HOCl aur OCl- se oxidise hote hain, cell ke kaam ko bigarte aur cell ki maut tak le jate hue; yeh bacteria ki baqa aur replication ke liye zaroori enzymes ko bhi oxidise aur na-faal karte hain, aur nucleic acids (DNA aur RNA) oxidise ho sakte hain, bacteria ko replicate hone aur zaroori cellular kaamon se rokte hue.

blocks.prompt: Pani mein bacteria maarne ke liye HOCl OCl- se zyada moassar disinfectant kyun hai (Quick Check 13.6a)?
blocks.explanation: HOCl par koi charge nahi, to woh bacteria ki cell deewar aur membrane se manfi charge wale OCl- ion se kahin aasani se guzarta hai, jise cell ki satah dhakelti hai; andar ja kar HOCl proteins, enzymes aur nucleic acids ko oxidise karta hai aur cell mar jata hai.

items: HOCl (neutral) OCl- se behtar cell deewaron mein ghusta hai; dono proteins, lipids, enzymes aur nucleic acids ko oxidise karte hain, bacteria maarte ya replication rokte hue.
